ocl.definition: foundLoanTerm:LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(lt | lt.ItemID = itemid and lt.Content = content)
ocl.postcondition: if foundLoanTerm.oclIsUndefined() then let newLt:LoanTerm in newLt.oclIsNew() and newLt.ItemID = itemid and newLt.Content = content and LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newLt) and result = true else result = false endif
